tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Decide whether a specific x402 payment should go through: returns allow true/false with reasons. Checks the endpoint's trust verdict, that the amount is within your cap and not above the monitored price, and that the payTo wallet matches the one we've observed (catches swapped or hijacked wallets).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?plans=1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: report_outcome, get_full_report · Private data: check_endpoint, check_payment, report_outcome, top_endpoints, get_full_report · Public sink: report_outcome.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: report_outcome, get_full_report · Private data: check_endpoint, check_payment, report_outcome, top_endpoints, get_full_report · Public sink: report_outcome

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_endpoint" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
